This flavone then exerts its effect on Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3, indicating a potential pathway where Abyssinone I may influence cellular processes through the regulation of Mcl-1, which could affect the activity of the transporter. The observed scores suggest a moderate level of interaction, but further validation would be needed to confirm the direct involvement of Abyssinone I in the regulation of Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3. The mechanism appears to involve a cascade of molecular interactions, with the transporter potentially being a downstream target of the flavone's effects, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be elucidated.
